refinements.prompt: Use case: texture-asset. Create one photorealistic PBR base-color square texture of worn matte charcoal-black enamel on an old railway equipment flight case. This is a FLAT raw albedo swatch, NOT an object, NOT a render, no perspective, no directional light, no shadows, no border, no labels, no panels, no seams, no handles, no visible geometry. Material colour is very dark neutral grey, mostly calm smooth charcoal (#252626 to #323333) with fine, barely visible sprayed paint micrograin. A few very small thin hairline scratches and subtle rubbed areas exposing dark dull grey metal, uneven faint dust along incidental patches, restrained authentic ageing, about 96 percent intact black paint. Think the black rectangular hard equipment trunk in a high-end photorealistic railway luggage trolley prop. The paint must look hard and smooth with restrained low contrast variation; NEVER leather, NEVER pebbled upholstery, NEVER marbled rock, NEVER cracked mud, NEVER a coarse repeating grain, NEVER thick white scratches. Texture detail is finely scaled; a full swatch represents about 60 by 60 centimetres of painted metal, so scratches are fine millimetre-scale traces. No high contrast white spots. Even diffuse illumination strictly suitable as base color for a physically based renderer, high fidelity natural photographic detail, square seamless edges.

purpose: Base-color material atlas for the Railhead luggage trolley; PBR channels and model authored by railhead_luggage.py.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, realistic game material authoring. Asset type: one square 2048x2048 PBR base-color texture atlas for a highly realistic old railway luggage trolley, wooden shipping crates, vintage flight cases and an olive canvas bedroll. The output must be a precisely aligned 4 by 4 grid of sixteen equal square material swatches, with zero gaps, zero borders, zero text and no objects. Each swatch is photographed directly perpendicular to a flat surface, edge-to-edge, neutral diffuse lighting, no lighting gradients, no cast shadows, no perspective, no highlights baked into the image. Real small-scale wear, understated colors, detailed natural surfaces. Row 1 left to right: (1) aged warm golden oak wood grain running horizontally, knots and fine worn fibers, no plank seams; (2) slightly darker weathered oak grain horizontally, no plank seams; (3) chipped muted sage grey-green industrial steel paint with tiny rusty spots and exposed dark steel, subtle scratches; (4) brushed dull silver steel, fine machining and scuffs. Row 2 left to right: (5) dark desaturated cobalt blue vintage metal flight-case paint, scratched and worn; (6) deep muted red painted metal flight-case surface, chipped and scuffed; (7) charcoal black worn textured hard-case surface; (8) dull off-white grey aluminium travel case surface. Row 3 left to right: (9) thick olive green canvas, fine visible weave and subtle small wrinkles, no straps; (10) near-black rubber tyre sidewall, fine grain and scuffed rubber, no circular shape; (11) dark charcoal woven webbing straps, fine straight weave, no buckles; (12) very dark aged brown-grey steel hardware, worn areas and gentle oxidation. Row 4 left to right: (13) restrained rusty steel patina, reddish brown with grey chips; (14) worn brushed aluminium corner protectors material, grey silver; (15) olive green woven webbing strap fabric; (16) dark black moulded case edging material, fine texture. Accurate sixteen identical square cells aligned at 25%,50%,75% of each axis. Must look like production-quality photorealistic material scans, not illustrations. Avoid excessive scratches, bright saturated colors, thick rust, vignette, collage margins, logos, hardware silhouettes, 3D renders or product pictures.
